take: ANA announced three moves: Nico Myatovic was assigned to San Diego (AHL), Troy Terry was activated from injured reserve, and Ryan Poehling went on long-term injured reserve. Poehling's absence is the bigger loss, since he played 14:15 a night and killed penalties. In the five games since he went out, Judd Caulfield has taken his spot beside Nesterenko and Killorn and is up to 15:22 a night from 11:19. Terry's return adds a forward who scored 19 goals last season, though ANA has been out-chanced at 5-on-5 with a 45% share of expected goals (the quality of chances).
